title: ephedra distachya subsp. monostachya
intro: Ephedra distachya subsp. monostachya, commonly known as Desert Borage, is a species of flowering plant in the Ephedraceae family. It is traditionally used for its health benefits, including reducing respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant and bronchodilatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to stimulate the cardiovascular system, improve circulation, and act as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents of Ephedra distachya subsp. monostachya include ephedrine alkaloids, such as ephedrine and pseudoephedrine, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
